{{Quote|The siege goes well. With our continued barrage, their shield should be down in three months.''"<br />"''But we've been here a month already.''"<br />"''Yes, sir. We're right on schedule.|Commander Cody and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=RightOnSchedule-CW22.flac|<ref name="CW22" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought on a [[Unidentified planet (shielded city)|planet]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led a force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in an extended campaign on the world against the Confederate [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], which was safely entrenched in a [[City/Legends|city]] protected by an [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]]. Using an underground tunnel, Skywalker and Kenobi were able to infiltrate the city and destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Once the shield was down, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] led the assault as [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] swarmed the city, leading to a Republic victory.

==The battle==
{{Quote|So, I assume the plan is to crawl through the sewer, work our way to the shield generator, fight our way through the defenses, blow up the generator, knocking out the shield and all our troops swarm in and overwhelm the enemy.''"<br />"''Yup, let's go!|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|audio=YupLetsGo-CWChapter22.flac|<ref name="CW22" />}}
[[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were in command of a large force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] on a [[Unidentified planet (shielded city)|planet with heavy precipitation]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="SW.com Forums" /> The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] were entrenched for a campaign expected to last for months, while their [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] bombardment wore down the [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]] covering a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-held [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="CW22" />

[[File:Shieldgenerator_cw22.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Battle droids guard the shield generator.]]
One month into the siege, a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]-equipped Commander Cody descended to the entrance of the ramshackle shelter Kenobi was resting in and informed the [[General/Legends|general]] that they were on schedule and under their continued bombardment of the city, the enemy [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] would be overwhelmed in a further three months. After Cody departed, Skywalker arrived with a meal he had obtained from the enemy camp after discovering an underground entrance into the city, running through the sewers beneath the protective shield.<ref name="CW22" />

While their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] continued their bombardment of the shield above ground, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] made their way through the sewers and into the underground levels of the city. From there, they made their way to the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] chamber and succeeded in destroying the generator with the use of explosives. With the shield down, Skywalker and Kenobi exited the city, leaving Commander Cody to lead a full scale attack including [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Clone jet troopers]] and [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] with [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters]] providing aerial support. The assault led to a Republic victory over the Separatist forces.<ref name="CW22" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Typical, the weather clears as soon as we're leaving.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=TypicalTheWeatherClears-CW22.flac|<ref name="CW22" />}}
[[File:CommenceAttack_cw22.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Clone troopers commence the attack on the city.]]
As the Republic forces were preparing to depart aboard [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], Kenobi and Skywalker received an urgent [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmission from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] had learned that the Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had been making frequent trips to the planet [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], and the two Jedi were dispatched to ascertain what interest the Separatists had in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world.<ref name="CW22" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was shown in the twenty-second episode of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated television series, and was originally aired on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[March 22]], [[2005]]. It was the second episode in the series' [[Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], and was released on the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume Two|Volume Two]] DVD.
